DERIVED by this session from item-1e600c98-webmap-data.json ("Board-Adopted Red II", converted to WGS84). 5 polygons, area letter in DISTRICT (A to E), NAME carries 2017-era member and term year, POPULATION is 2010 based.

LA County Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk layer "Registrar Recorder School Districts Trustee Areas" (item 56e294422060461bb9bf36c95aa4d262, last update September 2026), filtered to this district. GeoJSON, EPSG:4326 (requested outSR=4326; service native CRS EPSG:2229). One feature for the whole district (TRUSTEE_AREA null) plus one per trustee area; area number in TRUSTEE_AREA.
